Dr. Anut, the orthodontist, gave excellent advice, had a gentle voice, and was very gentle. I saw a clear change after the treatment was completed. I'm very impressed! Before, I didn't like showing my teeth, but now I smile a lot no matter what I'm doing. My protruding teeth made me very self-conscious; people would always ask about my teeth and stare, which I didn't like. I was always shy about smiling and hiding my teeth in photos. But after the treatment, I'm so confident and I smile all the time! I love looking in the mirror and smiling all the time. I was a little worried at first about the results and if the cost would spiral out of control, but once the payments were complete, there were no additional charges. There might have been some minor tartar removal, but if you maintain good dental hygiene, you won't need to pay extra. I was a little concerned because it took longer than I expected, probably because everyone's teeth are different and maybe my own habits also played a role. But believe me, the results are amazing!
